lines: * Zombies on the second floor now maledict.
* I think the sewers entrance from the forest is gone. Will investigate further
* Found another place under keep of barovia, maybe sewers have been replaced? included incomplete map
+   r (up to the keep, need fly)
| | |   mobs: kelpies (entwine and are fire immune)
|     |     |  |  |  |  |/ R - Down to ?? (without fly, you fall)
3 - The High Priest Kir (Flail named 'Frost Tongue')
7 - The Vampire Lord of the Keep (The Amulet of Ravenkind, Ba'al Verzi Dagger, blood red cape)
G - Good Guys (Grultix, Maglivale and Alisindara)
L - The Lich (Dagger of the Lich, finely embroidered hat), Locks Door Behind you, can Recall. Don't flee, you'll get PWK'd I promise, I tried it out.)
(Look in a pile of bones for a black rose ring, +20 hp +2 con)
(Translucent) (White Aura) A robed dwarf meditates here, surrounded by a holy glow.
<worn on feet>      a pair of leather sandals
<worn about body>   a worn brown robe
<worn on finger>    a golden ring set with a dragonseye
<worn around neck>  a braided mithril necklace
(White Aura) An elf garbed in bright platinum travels through these dark lands.
<worn on head>      a beautiful platinum helm
<worn as shield>    a platinum tower shield
<wielded>           a platinum blade, engraved with the sun
This object, a beautiful platinum helm, can be referred to as 'platinum dragon helm'.
It has been imbued with a blessing.
Those with a balanced soul cannot use it.
People of a dark heart cannot use it.
It is worth 2500 copper, and is of 26th level of power.
When worn, it protects you against piercing for 8,
bashing for 8, slashing for 8 and magic for 0 points each.
When worn, it affects your ability to do damage by 1 points and your ability to land accurate blows by 1 points.
This object, a platinum blade, engraved with the sun, can be referred to as 'platinum blade sun'.
It has been imbued with a blessing.
Those with a balanced soul cannot use it.
People of a dark heart cannot use it.
Only an elf could put it to use.
It is worth 5000 copper, and is of 26th level of power.
It can cause 6d4 points of damage, at average 15.
When worn, it affects your ability to do damage by 5 points and your ability to land accurate blows by 5 points.
